artworks.title: A Stage Design for an Opera with Actors
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink with gray and brown wash on laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand architectural interior. The image depicts a vast, elaborately decorated hall featuring numerous intricately carved columns and arches. The structure showcases a rich use of decorative stonework with twisted columns and ornate ceiling panels. The space is enclosed by a series of arches that suggest depth and grandeur, extending into the distance. The floor is composed of rectangular tiles leading the eye toward a focal point at the center of the composition. There are several statues alongside the architecture that add to the opulent and majestic ambiance, mimicking classical figures. The drawing utilizes contrasting tones to distinguish elements and create a sense of depth and three-dimensionality.

artworks.title: A Young Shepherd Playing a Pipe for Two Young Shepherdesses
artworks.medium: black chalk, pen and brown ink, and brown wash, on pink prepared paper, laid down on an old mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals outdoors. One person is seated playing a flute, another person is kneeling nearby, and a third person, likely a child, is beside them. The seated person has short, curly hair and is wearing a tunic. The kneeling person has hair tied up and wears a layered dress. Several dogs are lying nearby. Objects nearby include a basket of flowers, a hat, and a cane or shepherd's crook. The background features foliage, tree branches, and a stone wall or structure.

artworks.title: Design for a Decorative Panel with Two Sirens Holding a Vase Embellished with Dolphins and other Decorative Motifs
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate vase with intricate decorative elements. The central feature is an elaborately designed vase with floral motifs and scrolling foliage. At the base of the vase, two mythical creatures hold up the vase, surrounded by a garland of leaves and flowers. The body of the vase is detailed with festoons and classical decorations, including what appear to be masks or stylized creatures at the top. The background is filled with delicate, symmetrical tendrils and flourishes. The overall composition is elegant and reflects a style that emphasizes symmetry and ornamental beauty.

artworks.title: Décoration de sallon pour  Brunoy (Design for the Interior of the Château de Brunoy)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor on laid paper, laid down on an old album sheet
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior hall with neoclassical ornamentation. The ceiling features intricate designs with gold accents. The walls have columns, pilasters, art, and decorative elements. Golden sculptures holding candelabrums are placed along the walls. The color scheme consists of soft pastels, whites, and golds. The drawing conveys depth and perspective within the hall.

artworks.title: Jupiter
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash, squared in black chalk, with traces of framing lines in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: The image displays a man reclining on a cloud. He is looking towards the left and has a beard and curly hair. He is holding a staff with one arm while the other arm supports his head. The man is mostly unclothed, with a draped fabric around his waist. He wears a laurel crown and is surrounded by wings and floral decorations. The background is a monochromatic sepia tone.

artworks.title: An Academy Study of a Reclining Male Nude
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure lying on the ground. He is reclining on his back with his head tilted backward. His left arm is extended by his side while his right hand rests near his thigh. The person's face is not visible, and their hair is styled or resting naturally. The individual is nude, displaying the musculature and anatomical details of the body. There are no visible accessories. The background is softly shaded, creating depth behind the figure.

artworks.title: The Fall of the Rebel Angels
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash with touches of white gouache over traces of  black chalk, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures among clouds. The image shows several figures intertwined in dynamic poses against a cloudy background. There is a figure soaring through the sky with outstretched arms, suggesting motion or flight. The figures exhibit various expressive postures, including lying down or raising their arms upward. The drawing is executed in a style reminiscent of classical or Renaissance art, with shading and line work to convey depth and volume.

artworks.title: A Shepherd and a Shepherdess Resting
artworks.medium: watercolor over traces of black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: The painting depicts two figures in a pastoral scene. The image shows a rural setting with two individuals seated on the ground, surrounded by sheep and a small dog. The scene conveys tranquility with soft pastel colors and brushstrokes that capture nature. Lush foliage surrounds them, and a basket of flowers adds vibrancy. The painting conveys a mood of leisure and harmony with nature. The style is reminiscent of François Boucher.

artworks.title: Design for a Wall with Two Doors and a Sculpture
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, gray wash, and watercolor on two sheets of paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a standing figure with a draped garment holding an object. It is made of a material with a brownish hue, placed on a brown-toned pedestal with ornate patterns, situated in front of a grand architectural facade. The facade features fluted pilasters and decorative panels, with a ceiling above the sculpture adorned with an arched starburst pattern. The composition is refined and symmetrical, complementing the classical architectural setting.

artworks.title: The Declaration of Love
artworks.medium: red, black, and white chalk with red wash on laid paper, laid down on an old mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals in a lively, animated pose. The woman stands with her body slightly turned, her left hand resting on the man's upper arm. She wears a large hat with bows, her dress adorned with intricate details and voluminous skirts. She appears playful and smiles. The man is slightly bent towards her, holding a cane with his left hand. He is dressed in a fitted suit with lace trim. The background features soft foliage and a lattice or trellis design, with three human faces visible on the right.

artworks.title: A View of the Piazza San Marco in Florence
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: The image displays an urban square from an elevated viewpoint, showing various activities. There buildings such as a church with a spire and pedestrians are visible. The drawing is detailed with fine lines and shading in shades of grey and tan. People are seen walking and conversing, with others in carriages or dispersed throughout the square, creating depth in the scene.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait Writing with a Companion
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E. M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of two individuals seated at a table. The person on the left is facing forward, with their head slightly tilted towards the viewer. They have medium-length hair and appear to be wearing a cap. Their facial features are depicted with fine lines, and they have a serious expression. The figure is dressed in a loose garment with a wide collar, and their arms are rested on the table. The person on the right leans slightly forward and to the left, looking directly at the viewer with a thoughtful expression. This person has short hair and similar facial features, with a broad collar on their attire. An inkpot and rolled papers or scrolls are visible on the table in front of them. The background is blank, emphasizing the two figures and the objects on the table.

artworks.title: Mendicant Family of a Fallen Hero (Scena simbolica--Gruppo di famiglia dell'eroe caduto con elmetto)
artworks.medium: etching on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image is an etching of three figures in left profile. The central figure is a woman, seated and leaning slightly forward, with curly hair and a shawl covering her head and shoulders. To her left stands an older figure in a hood, and to her right is a child holding a bowl or hat-shaped object. The background is plain with cross-hatching and textural shading, with faint letters and numbers in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting two figures in a natural setting. Both individuals are shown from head to toe. The person on the left is seated with a beard, head resting on their hand. They have short, slightly curly hair. The person on the right is also seated, with long, flowing hair cascading down their back and partially across their face, holding a small object. Both wear long robes. Surrounding them are tall, leafy palm trees and sparse vegetation. In the sky above, there are ambiguous figures. The background suggests a natural landscape, possibly coastal or desert.

artworks.title: Winter Evening
artworks.medium: etching with monotype wiping (more heavily inked version)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from the Estate of Lila Oliver Asher
artworks.description: The image displays a waterway with trees on both sides extending into the distance. The horizon is low, the sky above is softly textured, and the artist's technique combines stippling and linear etching. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of gray.

artworks.title: Winter Evening
artworks.medium: etching with monotype wiping, printed in sepia on heavy wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from the Estate of Lila Oliver Asher
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a narrow river or stream, lined with bare trees in the middle ground. The trees are intricately depicted with fine lines, as is the texture of the ground. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic color scheme with varying shades of brown. Vegetation borders the river on one side, while lighter vegetation is on the other side. There are reflections on the water's surface under a speckled sky.

artworks.title: Countryside
artworks.medium: etching with monotype wiping on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from the Estate of Lila Oliver Asher
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow, winding waterway surrounded by dense trees. On the left, tall, leafless trees stretch across the sky, while on the right, dense foliage creates a dark mass. The brushstrokes are intricate, creating a defined texture. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic palette of deep browns and dark sepia tones, evoking a moody atmosphere.

artworks.title: Coastal View (A Foreboding of Sadness)
artworks.medium: etching with monotype wiping, printed in sepia on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from the Estate of Lila Oliver Asher
artworks.description: The image depicts a wide, open landscape with the horizon slightly below the center. A dark, horizontal band defines the horizon with a flock of birds flying. The artwork uses soft brushstrokes to create a dreamy atmosphere, especially in the sky with gentle, diffused clouds. The color palette is primarily sepia tones, giving a warm and nostalgic effect. A reflection on water mirrors the horizon, while soft clouds in the distance enhance the serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: A May Evening at Lierna, 2
artworks.medium: etching with monotype wiping on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from the Estate of Lila Oliver Asher
artworks.description: The image shows a tranquil scene with a figure sitting near the water's edge. In the background, there are large mountains. The sky is lightly clouded, and the color palette is monochrome with various shades of gray. The artwork has a soft, sketch-like texture.

artworks.title: Stream in the Woods
artworks.medium: etching with monotype wiping on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from the Estate of Lila Oliver Asher
artworks.description: This image depicts a forest landscape from an elevated perspective. The scene shows tall trees creating a canopy that obscures the horizon, with a river flowing through the trees. The artwork features soft, textured strokes giving it an atmospheric quality. The color palette is primarily dark shades of gray and black, enhancing the mysterious mood. The distant trees appear denser, providing depth to the image and leading the eye into the forest.

artworks.title: Ciacole (Gossips)
artworks.medium: monotype on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in blurry forms, grouped closely together. Their facial features are indistinct, and their hair appears voluminous. The figures are wearing dark, flowing clothing. One of them is holding an object. The background is abstract. The artwork is in black and white tones.

artworks.title: Mercury Abducting Psyche
artworks.artist: Jan Muller, after Adriaen de Vries
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This print shows a statue that depicts two intertwined figures with nude, muscular bodies. A woman on the left is in profile, facing the right. She has a braided hairstyle and holds a pitcher of water above her head. The man on the right wears a helmet with wings, and there are more small wings on his ankles. He is lifting the woman up into the air, one arm around her shoulders and one around her right leg. He looks up at her. The background is made of thin horizontal lines, and the pedestal of the statue features several lines of text.

artworks.title: Révolution, Famille désespérée
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on light blue-green laid paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a detailed interior setting. The central figure, a man with wavy hair, gestures towards a woman and several children. The woman and children have curly hair and wear elaborate historical clothing. The background features a decorative column, ornate moldings, and a staircase with a railing. Strong lighting creates dramatic shadows on the walls and floor tiles.

artworks.title: Nick Biddle
artworks.medium: albumen silver print (carte-de-visite)
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image portrays a man with mature facial features, a full beard, and short textured hair. He sits or stands upright, facing slightly towards the camera. He wears a buttoned-up jacket that seems to be a uniform with shoulder straps and buttons down the front. An item hangs from his right side. The background is plain, contrasting subtly with his clothing and complexion. At the bottom of the image, text provides context about the individual named Nick Biddle.
